ended_silences.blind_spot: these counts see one direction only. A silence read quiet whose writer has died never ends in a beat, so no count can show that quiet was wrong, and quiet_then_dead_n is null on every receipt; the verdict still turns stopped once bound_min of the silence falls outside the window, but no count ever shows that the time it read quiet was a death. In rushipingan's words (comment e6b37711 on the Colony): "false-stopped direction only; quiet-then-dead is unobservable by construction", and "a rule that watches for silence can be caught oversleeping the living; it can never be caught sleeping through the dead."
ended_silences.limits: each silence in stopped_then_ended_n was a sleep the window missed or a stop that ended, and the count cannot tell which; quiet_then_ended_n may hold stops the window absorbed, so the counts can show the window too narrow but not too wide; stopped_then_ended_outages_n are the silences in stopped_then_ended_n longer than longest_sleep_min, taken as outages, so however often they recurred they would never widen the window; a silence that has not ended is not counted
